### T-ASSEMBLE-PREFIX

**Integrate all four bands on their common domain**

P0 · synthesis · Blocked · Unclaimed

- **Target** · [BANDS](GRAPH.md#bands)
- **Prerequisites** · [OUTER](GRAPH.md#outer), [FIRST](GRAPH.md#first), [EARLY](GRAPH.md#early), [MIDDLE](GRAPH.md#middle), [LAST-EIGHT](GRAPH.md#last-eight), [PREFIX-INDUCTION](GRAPH.md#prefix-induction)
- **Related results** · None

**Inputs**

Use the verified outside construction, four growth bands, integer endpoints and from_rounding. A witness can be replaced between consecutive existential steps.

**Deliverable**

Submit the full uniform conditional instantiation including all small covered cases, band interfaces and the external last-seven theorem.

**Acceptance**

Every open input is supplied or linked to its accepted proof, with t ranging over all D. Compile the Lean theorem when formalized and audit equivalence to the original square target.

**Fallback**

If a band proves only a subfamily, record the exact residual t,j. Leave the global gate open.

### T-FIRST-MATCH

**Force the first equal integer signature**

P0 · research · Claimed · Codex · `hadamard/first-match-atlas` · 2026-11-27

- **Target** · [COLLISION](GRAPH.md#collision)
- **Prerequisites** · [PIVOT](GRAPH.md#pivot), [SIGNATURE](GRAPH.md#signature)
- **Related results** · [SIGNATURE-ATLAS](GRAPH.md#signature-atlas), [FRACTIONAL-VERTEX](GRAPH.md#fractional-vertex), [SIGNED-FIRST](GRAPH.md#signed-first), [UNIVERSAL-CERTIFICATE](GRAPH.md#universal-certificate), [PAIR-DEFECT](GRAPH.md#pair-defect), [POWER45-COVER](GRAPH.md#power45-cover), [ONE-COLUMN-28](GRAPH.md#one-column-28)

**Inputs**

For k-subsets compare the two signature supports. N₁ is their multiplicity inner product; the two fractional barycentres already agree. The input assumption is existence of some valid Gram pair at this t.

**Deliverable**

Prove a positive coefficient in common for a specified family of valid pairs or show how to replace a given pair by one with positive overlap. Record the family as a predicate on t and on the two matrices. The row-pair class and the power-45 progression are established. Extend coverage to a different part of D or prove the general existential statement.

**Acceptance**

Both subsets have size k, the equality holds in all b coordinates and any representative change preserves the joint Gram. To close COLLISION cover every t in D under its existential premise.

**Fallback**

A valid pair with N₁=0 refutes fixed-pair matching and becomes a replacement benchmark. Supply both full support certificates. A full solution at a known order remains a control.

### T-LOW-TRADES

**Repair a single alternating four-cycle of defect**

P0 · research · Ready · Unclaimed

- **Target** · [SWITCH-LOW](GRAPH.md#switch-low)
- **Prerequisites** · [FOUR-CYCLE](GRAPH.md#four-cycle), [SWITCH-FORMULA](GRAPH.md#switch-formula)
- **Related results** · [ODD-CUT](GRAPH.md#odd-cut)

**Inputs**

With four-cycle positive edges uw and vx, one switch repairs exactly when two rows of either A or B have respective set differences {u,w} and {v,x}. Use the exact switch formula to study neutral moves when neither matrix has that pair.

**Deliverable**

Give a uniform energy-four repair allowing neutral moves, or a certified trapped plateau. First classify a nontrivial family in which neutral moves create the proven one-switch row configuration.

**Acceptance**

A uniform proof covers every legal outside-row pattern and both matrices and keeps the promised energy bound. A counterexample supplies the regular matrices, exhaustive neutral closure and all exit energies. A bounded-radius search is labelled with its radius.

**Fallback**

Return a verified neutral-move implication strictly extending the known one-switch criterion, or a precise blocked row profile with replayable evidence.

## P1

### T-CERTIFICATE-SUPPLY

**Build enough distinct universally compatible columns**

P1 · research · Ready · Unclaimed

- **Target** · [CERTIFICATE-SUPPLY](GRAPH.md#certificate-supply)
- **Prerequisites** · [UNIVERSAL-CERTIFICATE](GRAPH.md#universal-certificate), [PAIR-DEFECT](GRAPH.md#pair-defect)
- **Related results** · [STAR-CRITERION](GRAPH.md#star-criterion), [POWER45-COVER](GRAPH.md#power45-cover), [ONE-COLUMN-28](GRAPH.md#one-column-28), [ASSEMBLY](GRAPH.md#assembly)

**Inputs**

At one t in D outside the 45-power family use integral c of sum two and Z(c)=(YYᵀ−tI)c−(t−1)1. For t=599 the sufficient degree is 1190. A full or one-short star is impossible. For r missing star exchanges, first quotient by equal-half incidence words on the 2r leftover rows and use the binary rank bound 2r−2.

**Deliverable**

Resolve a residual case, starting with the two allowed exceptional-word patterns for degree 1195 at t=599, or construct distinct binary images from more general c on one verified design. A parametric construction may target any uncovered subfamily.

**Acceptance**

Verify the outside Gram, integrality, coefficient sums, all output bits and distinct images on a common Y. For complete order coverage reach h=2t−8 and cite completion. For the global node cover every t in its stated remainder.

**Fallback**

An exclusion must name its degree, coefficient support or family of designs. Record the exact residual cases and a reusable obstruction.

### T-CLIQUE

**Build a jointly compatible large selector family**

P1 · research · Ready · Unclaimed

**Inputs**

Given a pair with many matching signatures, its vertices carry exact row labels and edges encode overlap. Split a candidate witness into two groups with all cross edges present.

**Deliverable**

Find cliques of certified sizes c,d with a common pair and complete cross adjacency. Give a mechanism for c+d≥h throughout a stated family of t or an exact deficit and the cases still missing.

**Fallback**

Present a failed gluing example with cross-overlap histogram, or a rigorously justified smaller threshold c+d that new work can raise.

### T-GOOD-TYPE

### T-HIGH-DESCENT

**Find a descent above the four-cycle band**

P1 · research · Ready · Unclaimed

- **Target** · [SWITCH-HIGH](GRAPH.md#switch-high)
- **Prerequisites** · [SWITCH-FORMULA](GRAPH.md#switch-formula), [FOUR-CYCLE](GRAPH.md#four-cycle)
- **Related results** · [SWITCH-LOW](GRAPH.md#switch-low)

**Inputs**

The defect has signed degree zero. Decompose its multiset of positive/negative unit edges into alternating closed walks and compare those walks to actual alternating switches in A or B.

**Deliverable**

Prove a switch-path descent for a nontrivial class of defects and identify what it takes to cover all E>4. Treat neutral moves with a well-founded secondary quantity or a finite-path construction.

**Acceptance**

Every proposed switch has the required two ones and two zeros in its actual matrix. Check all claimed changes with the energy formula and that a smaller integer endpoint is reached. Every intermediate energy must be at most the initial energy.

**Fallback**

A state with no immediate improving move refutes only strict one-switch descent. Publish the plateau boundary or the still-missing alternating-walk realizability statement.

### T-PAIR-SEED

### T-SATURATED

**Repair after deficits become zero or full**

P1 · research · Ready · Unclaimed

- **Target** · [MIDDLE](GRAPH.md#middle)
- **Prerequisites** · [AUGMENTED-KEY](GRAPH.md#augmented-key), [FRACTIONAL](GRAPH.md#fractional)
- **Related results** · [FRACTIONAL-VERTEX](GRAPH.md#fractional-vertex), [EARLY](GRAPH.md#early)

**Inputs**

For a supplied admissible width j in the middle band, preassign forced bits. Form the remaining incidence matrix M and right hand side y after subtracting contributions of forced ones. The fractional numerators give Mp=sy. The order of the obstruction class of y in the integer cokernel divides s; primes coprime to s cannot obstruct.

**Deliverable**

Identify an integral binary repair or a replacement prefix. For a fixed failure, test primes dividing s=b−j or their powers. A first deliverable is wᵀM=0 and wᵀy≠0 over a stated modulus, verified after the forced bits are removed.

**Acceptance**

A witness must meet every reduced count and both row boundaries. To close MIDDLE prove existence of a suitable witness throughout a≤j<h−1; a dead fixed prefix leaves other witnesses available.

**Fallback**

Record the forced sets, rank/residue witness, precise t,j and the size of the smallest replacement tested. Preserve all row labels for replay.

### T-TERMINAL-MOVE

**Replace one terminal column via a 256-pattern test**

P1 · research · Ready · Unclaimed

- **Target** · [GOOD-DIRECT](GRAPH.md#good-direct)
- **Prerequisites** · [EXCHANGE-NINE](GRAPH.md#exchange-nine), [LAST-SEVEN](GRAPH.md#last-seven)

**Inputs**

Given n−8 columns, delete one and keep all other n−9. Enumerate the signs in the nine-dimensional kernel modulo negation. Test pairs by their full scalar products; try other deletions with separate coverage records.

**Deliverable**

Return either two compatible columns yielding n−7 or a replayable certificate excluding every such replacement over each specified retained prefix. Then seek a condition guaranteeing a successful deletion on some prefix throughout a family.

**Acceptance**

Coordinate lifting is rank checked, includes all 256 patterns, and cross-products use full length n. To close GOOD-DIRECT, guarantee some good original or reconstructed prefix for every required t admitting one.

**Fallback**

A failed replacement atlas establishes its exact local radius and motivates changing two earlier columns. Give the old columns, identities of all deletions, and masks.

### T-DESIGNS

P2 · research · Ready · Unclaimed

- **Target** · [DESIGN-UNIFORM](GRAPH.md#design-uniform)
- **Prerequisites** · [DESIGN-EQUIV](GRAPH.md#design-equiv), [KNOWN-ORDERS](GRAPH.md#known-orders)
- **Related results** · [TAIL](GRAPH.md#tail)

**Inputs**

The exact parameters are v=4t−1, w=2t−1, λ=t−1. Pair counts force both replication and block count, so a nonnegative integral edge decomposition suffices.

**Deliverable**

Find a theorem or new composition rule producing these precise parameters on an infinite class. Derive explicitly its threshold, divisibility assumptions and coverage under parameter growth.

**Acceptance**

Any bound of the form v≥v₀(w,λ) must actually hold along the stated sequence. Cite the theorem and verify its other hypotheses or give an independent constructive proof.

**Fallback**

An explicit inequality showing a proposed theorem never reaches the growing-block regime closes that shortcut and identifies the additional estimate needed.

- **Related results** · [FINITE-2396](GRAPH.md#finite-2396)

**Inputs**

Use the labelled design bits of DESIGN-EQUIV. Begin at order 8 or 12 with all row, column and pair counts. Normalizing further requires an explicit representative proof.

**Deliverable**

Give the encoder/decoder, replay a satisfiable positive control, then replay a proof of contradiction for a deliberately perturbed control (e.g. two points forced equal while pair counts are retained). Record the exact instance hashes.

**Acceptance**

Check encoding in both directions, decode the SAT square and verify all scalar products. Replay the UNSAT certificate independently and mark its extra constraint explicitly. This completes only the harness card.

**Fallback**

A solver verdict without a replayable proof stays an unverified experiment. Do not treat failure of the mutated control as a conjecture counterexample.

### T-TAIL

**Derive a genuine cofinite construction**

P2 · research · Ready · Unclaimed

- **Target** · [TAIL](GRAPH.md#tail)
- **Prerequisites** · [KNOWN-ORDERS](GRAPH.md#known-orders), [ODD-REDUCTION](GRAPH.md#odd-reduction)
- **Related results** · [HALF-BOUND](GRAPH.md#half-bound)

**Inputs**

Investigate a parametric construction or a finite cover of residue/exception classes. Known asymptotic partial matrices and known dense families are baselines.

**Deliverable**

Deliver an explicit T and an all-order argument on D above T, or an exact subfamily cover with a proven bound on its complement.

**Acceptance**

Check the order is exactly 4t at every use, including tensor-product factors. Link all classes to a mathematical cover. To close TAIL return one numerical cutoff plus proof.

**Fallback**

If a progression survives all substitutions, give it with a divisibility or density proof. It becomes a named new family rather than a false finite cutoff.
